about: Which recorded flights the bake makes (plan 03, F1.2 and F2.2). Kept in the repository, not served: the ICAO address and archive release make each bake reproducible from raw/<id>.trace.json.gz, weather/<id>.json and cifp-KLAS.json without the archive or the network. Edit and run `uv run scripts/bake_flight.py lv` once (it fetches the weather of a new flight), then `uv run scripts/bake_flights.py lv` (offline; --check proves the committed files are what it makes).

flights.fetched: 2026-11-24, from https://github.com/adsblol/globe_history_2026/releases/tag/v2026.02.16-planes-readsb-prod-0 (the release PREFERRED_RELEASES.txt names for the day)
flights.reason: A 737-900 (B739, the 737-800's cabin cross-section and windows, acceptable under section 6.2) landing on 19R at 08:05 local with the sun 17.6 deg up. It meets every selection criterion of 6.2 that one flight can: trace from 65 min before touchdown, 30,316 ft at 24 min out; 100% ADS-B positions and geometric altitude; longest gaps 20.0 s above 18,000 ft, 14.4 s below 10,000 ft, 3.3 s in the last 5 km; 397 s of surface positions; one approach, no go-around; calm, visibility 10 mi, no ceiling below 23,000 ft; a winter day; arrives from the north-east (the CHOWW side). It also passes every quality gate of section 7.2. The one 737-800 on 19 by day that met the selection criteria (abc7e9, below) fails three gates on the flight as recorded, so section 6.2's substitute rule applies: a B738 meeting the whole of both could not be found in the days scanned.
flights.note: The transponder reported the surface format only from 16:05:05Z, 14 s after the wheels touched; the touchdown is where the vertical rate levelled on the runway (adsb.refine_touchdown).

flights.reason: A 737-800 (B738) landing on 19R at 23:42 local on 9 March 2026, the sun 54 deg below the horizon: runway 19 at night with the Strip to the right. It meets every selection criterion of 6.2: trace from 6.5 h before touchdown, 30,475 ft at 24 min out; 100% ADS-B positions and geometric altitude; longest gaps 20.0 s above 18,000 ft, 8.5 s below 10,000 ft, 3.3 s in the last 5 km; 344 s of surface positions; one approach, no go-around; calm, visibility 10 mi, no ceiling (FEW250); a spring night, a different month from lv-19-day; arrives from the east. It passes every quality gate of 7.2 and the procedure check (glide path 3.00 deg over 3 to 1 km, 0.04 deg from the PAPI's 3.04). Chosen over the other 737-800s on 19R that night (abb8a0, abefdd, abec26, abaa0e, aaf5a9, ab5bd4: incomplete before 24 min out or gaps) and over the 19L night 737-800s of 2026-09-18 (abc432, abadd6, abd559, abae62), which each miss the last-minute height gate by 0.3 to 0.6 m on a 31 C, gusty evening.

flights.reason: A 737-800 (B738) landing on 26L at 08:19 local on 10 March 2026, the sun 15.4 deg up in the east behind the aircraft: straight in from the east over Lake Mead and Henderson, as section 6.2 wants for this flight. It meets every selection criterion of 6.2: trace from 3.5 h before touchdown, 30,600 ft at 24 min out; 100% ADS-B positions and geometric altitude; longest gaps 25.5 s above 18,000 ft, 13.2 s below 10,000 ft, 6.3 s in the last 5 km; 616 s of surface positions; one approach, no go-around; calm, visibility 10 mi, no ceiling. It passes every quality gate of 7.2 and the procedure check (glide path 3.12 deg, 0.12 from the published 3.00). The sun is only just above the 15 deg the criterion asks; the later March mornings from the east fail a gate (ad6116 09:05, deceleration 3.75 m/s2; ac066b 10:34, last-minute height RMS 3.59 m), as do the February mornings (abd559 crossing height 35.3 m, abe7c5 deceleration 4.4 m/s2, ab93a5 deceleration 3.5 m/s2) and the September 26L mornings (abae62 height RMS 3.18 m). a12378 (2026-09-18 13:12, from the east) passes every gate but flew its final at 165 to 170 kt indicated with flaps 30 or less, too fast for any 737-800 weight, and is afternoon.

flights.reason: A 737-800 (B738) landing on 26L at 19:56 local on 15 February 2026 (03:56:30Z on the 16th), the sun 32 deg below the horizon. It meets every selection criterion of 6.2: trace from 2.5 h before touchdown, 30,725 ft at 24 min out; 100% ADS-B positions and geometric altitude; longest gaps 20.0 s above 18,000 ft, 14.4 s below 10,000 ft, 5.6 s in the last 5 km; 399 s of surface positions; one approach, no go-around; wind 190 at 5 kt, visibility 10 mi, lowest ceiling 20,000 ft (BKN200); a winter evening; arrives from the south-east. It passes every quality gate of 7.2 and the procedure check (glide path 3.06 deg, 0.06 from the published 3.00). Its rollout passed the gates only once the bake stopped trusting the stale airborne ground speed the transponder repeats after touchdown (smooth.stale_velocity). Chosen over abc49b (2026-03-10 21:15, from the east), which also passes but flew a 2.70 deg final, near the 0.35 deg limit, and over the other February night 737-800s (abd135, abd17b, abad6c, ab6247: last-minute height RMS 3.6 m or deceleration over 3.5 m/s2).

flights.reason: A 737-800 (B738) landing on 26L at 11:45 local on 1 January 2026 under an overcast at 500 ft (KLAS 011956Z 00000KT 7SM OVC005 08/07), after a morning of drizzle, light rain and mist with visibility down to 1.5 mi: the weather flight of section 6.2 (a broken or overcast layer below 8,000 ft), flown on the 26L ILS and in cloud until short final. It meets every selection criterion of 6.2: trace from 70 min before touchdown, 30,800 ft at 24 min out; 100% ADS-B positions and geometric altitude; longest gaps 22.1 s above 18,000 ft, 9.3 s below 10,000 ft, 5.4 s in the last 5 km; 155 s of surface positions; one approach, no go-around; winter; arrives from the east. It passes every quality gate of 7.2 and the procedure check (glide path 3.13 deg, 0.13 from the ILS's 3.00). Chosen over the morning's rain arrivals, which each miss the last-minute height gate (abd4e7 09:04, 3.71 m; abe030 09:20 in 1.5 mi, 3.62 m; abc40d 06:54 at dawn, 4.27 m), and 0d071b (12:18), whose position RMS below 300 m is 5.01 m against 5.

alternatives.why not: Meets every selection criterion (12:30 local, sun 41 deg, from the south-east, 160 s on the surface) but fails three of section 7.2's gates on what was recorded: glide path 3.44 deg from 3 km to 1 km against 3.00 published for 19L (the raw points alone give 3.40: it came down to the path from above and crossed under it); deceleration 3.69 m/s2 against 3.5 (97 to 77 kt in 2.3 s in the recording); height RMS 3.65 m in the last 60 s against 3, the jitter of its 25 ft altitudes. To use it, put it in `flights` with id lv-19-day (raw: `uv run scripts/find_arrivals.py lv 2026-02-16 --extract abc7e9 --id lv-19-day`, from data/raw/adsb) and bake with --allow-fail.

A 737-800 on 26L at 21:15 local on 9 March from the east; passes every gate, but its final is 2.70 deg, 0.30 from the published 3.00 (warn beyond 0.2). The alternative to lv-26-night if a night from the east (over Lake Mead) matters more than the angle: `uv run scripts/find_arrivals.py lv 2026-03-10 --extract abc49b --id lv-26-night` (from data/raw/adsb), update the entry in `flights`, run bake_flight.py once.

Passes every gate (26L at 13:12 local on 17 September, from the east), but flew its final at 165 to 170 kt indicated, too fast for flaps 30 at any 737-800 landing weight (the weight inference hits its 72 t limit), and in the afternoon rather than the morning section 6.2 asks for.

The best runway 19 dusk arrival found in the days scanned before 2026-05-23 (18:48 local on 9 March, sun 2.0 deg below, from the east): meets every selection criterion but its last-minute height RMS is 3.62 m against the 3 m gate.

dusk: No runway 19 dusk flight passing every gate of section 7.2 was found in the three dusk evenings scanned (2026-03-10, 2026-05-23, 2026-09-18 UTC). The nearest is ac4ffb (alternatives): a 737 MAX 8 on 19R at 18:48 local on 9 March, which meets every selection criterion and fails only the last-minute height RMS (3.62 m against 3 m, the scatter of its 25 ft GNSS heights). To ship it as lv-19-dusk: `uv run scripts/find_arrivals.py lv 2026-03-10 --extract ac4ffb --id lv-19-dusk` (from data/raw/adsb), add an entry to `flights`, and accept the gate (bake with --allow-fail; test_baked_files.test_the_quality_gates_pass would need an exception).
